mainTags.title: Main Tags
mainTags.description: Documents are grouped by these items on the Documents page, in this order. An item is one Tag, or a combination of two or more: its Documents carry all of them.
mainTags.empty: No Main Tags: Documents won't be grouped.
mainTags.noMoreTags: Every Tag is already a Main Tag.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Every Tag of this Room. Deleting a Tag removes it from the Documents, the Main Tags and the combinations that use it; the Documents themselves stay.
tags.confirmBody: The Tag is removed from every Document that has it and from the Main Tags. Combinations that used it shrink, and are removed if fewer than two Tags are left. Documents are not deleted. This cannot be undone.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Deleting the Room permanently removes it with its members, Documents, Comments, Notes and images.
dangerZone.confirmBody: Everything in this Room is deleted for everyone: members, invitations, Tags, Documents, Comments, Notes and images. This cannot be undone.
